items.stem: Why is it colder in winter than in summer in most places? (Select ONE)

options.text: The Sun is lower in the sky and days are shorter, so less warmth reaches the ground
options.rationale: Correct: the tilt lowers the Sun and shortens days in winter.

options.text: The Earth moves much closer to the Sun in winter
options.rationale: Distance is not the cause; the tilt is.

options.text: The Sun switches off in winter
options.rationale: The Sun keeps shining all year.

options.text: Clouds block all the Sun every winter day
options.rationale: Clouds vary; they are not the reason for the season.

items.explanation: Correct: the tilt lowers the Sun and shortens days in winter.

items.stem: Select TWO clues that help you tell it is autumn in a cool country. (Select TWO)

options.text: Leaves on many trees turn brown and fall
options.rationale: Correct: falling leaves are a common autumn sign.
Correct: shortening, cooling days signal autumn.

options.text: Flowers first appear after the coldest months
It is the hottest part of the whole year
